8387.description_text: What Are Our Biotin Gummies? Commonly known as the beauty vitamin, biotin (or Vitamin B7) is a water-soluble vitamin that contributes to the maintenance of normal hair and normal skin. Since it’s commonly found in animal-based foods like eggs, fish, and liver, vegetarians may not be getting enough. That’s where our vegetarian-friendly Biotin Gummies come in! Each serving contains 5000μg of biotin, blended together with 12 additional vitamins, minerals and vital nutrients for your wellness. These gummy-bear treats also come in a natural mixed berry flavour so your daily dose is a delicious treat that you'll look forward to. With 120 gummies, you can enjoy tasty biotin support for 2 months without needing to reorder frequently. Benefits of Our Biotin Gummies Biotin, or vitamin B7, has been studied extensively for it's range of benefits for your wellness. 8432.description_text: What Are Our Vitamin D3 Gummies? Have you been getting enough of the “sunshine vitamin”? Vitamin D3 is mostly found in animal-based foods like fish, eggs, red meat and dairy products, making it tougher for vegetarians to reap vitamin D. That’s why we've developed our vegetarian Vitamin D3 Gummies. With only one tasty lemon-flavoured gummy per day, you can get all the vitamin D3 your body needs! Benefits of Our Vitamin D3 Gummies Vitamin D3 is a fat-soluble vitamin that’s also known as the “sunshine vitamin”. This is because your skin produces vitamin D3 when exposed to UV rays in sunlight. Vitamin D3 is quite difficult to obtain through your regular diet, which is why supplementation is necessary to avoid deficiency. As per the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), vitamin D contributes to: Maintenance of normal bones* Maintenance of normal muscle function* Maintenance of normal teeth* Normal absorption/utilisation of calcium and phosphorus* Normal blood calcium levels* Normal function of the immune system* Has a role in the process of cell division* Why Choose WeightWorld’s Vitamin D3 Gummies? When combined, these two active ingredients provide a well-rounded mix of properties and are designed to complement a holistic way of life. 8462.description_text: What Are Vegan Collagen Advanced Capsules? Collagen is a vital protein that is present in your skin, hair, nails, bones, ligaments, and more. Since it’s mostly derived from animals, getting the goodness of collagen can be a real struggle for vegans and vegetarians. If you’re looking for a plant-based collagen alternative, then look no further! Our Vegan Collagen Advanced offers you twelve nature-derived ingredients that aim to be the building blocks of collagen. Unlike other collagen supplements on the market, our advanced collagen supplement also contains 500 million probiotics, offering the additional benefits of microbes. So, take your wellness and beauty regime to the next level with our Vegan Collagen Advanced Capsules today! Benefits of Our Vegan Collagen Advanced Capsules As we age, our body’s ability to form collagen starts declining. Our advanced collagen capsules infuse a range of essential nutrients to support your body’s collagen production and nourish it within. Read below to find out how the natural ingredients in our collagen capsules impact your well-being. 8468.description_text: What Are Our Magnesium Gummies for Kids? Is your child too lethargic or feeling weak? It is important to make sure they get the right balance of nutrients for their proper growth. Magnesium is a key nutrient among them as it is known to contribute to a reduction of tiredness and fatigue* and the maintenance of normal bones and teeth*, making it a must-have for your child's overall well-being. We know the daily struggle of convincing kids to take their supplement; that’s why we’ve made nutrition effortless and enjoyable! We have formulated our mixed berry and apple-flavoured Magnesium Gummies, a chewable and delicious alternative to magnesium tablets, specially made to make magnesium dosage fun for your little ones. Providing 80mg of elemental magnesium per gummy, our potent Magnesium Gummies are made with highly absorbable magnesium citrate, so that it gets easily absorbed. Benefits of Magnesium Gummies for Kids Our Magnesium Gummies support your child's well-being with all the wellness benefits that magnesium offers, but in a delicious form. According to the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA), magnesium: Contributes to normal energy-yielding metabolism* Contributes to electrolyte balance* Contributes to a reduction of tiredness and fatigue* Contributes to normal muscle function* Contributes to the maintenance of normal bones* Contributes to the maintenance of normal teeth* Contributes to normal protein synthesis* Contributes to normal functioning of the nervous system* Contributes to normal psychological function* Has a role in the process of cell division* Why Choose maxmedix Magnesium Gummies for Kids? Here’s why our Magnesium Gummies are the right pick for your little one! 8470.description_text: What Are Our Probiotic Gummies? Our gut has to maintain a significant amount of microbes (probiotics) for our body's well-being. Although some foods like yoghurt and pickles do provide such microbes, these may not be enough to meet your daily probiotic needs. We created a probiotic supplement in the form of tasty, Strawberry- and Vanilla-flavoured gummies that combine the goodness of prebiotics and probiotics in one. Our Probiotic Gummies are vegan, gluten-free, and formulated to fulfil your daily probiotic needs. This probiotic supplement offers 5 billion CFU of Bacillus Coagulans, a probiotic strain known for its ability to form spores, making it highly resistant to internal acids. In each serving of our high-strength gummies, you also get the benefits of 100μg of prebiotic fibre, Inulin. Benefits of Probiotic Gummies Probiotics are vital to your gut and for your overall well-being. 8472.description_text: What Are Our Mushroom Complex Gummies? Looking for a way to get the benefits of mushrooms, but without swallowing bitter tablets or large capsules? While mushrooms are a natural source of essential vitamins, minerals and nutrients, it can be difficult to incorporate them into your daily diet. Then our delicious Mushroom Complex Gummies may be the right choice for you! Each gummy brings together 8 types of mushrooms, namely, shiitake mushroom, chaga mushroom, maitake mushroom, white mushroom, reishi mushroom, royal sun mushroom, auricularia auricula extract, and organic hericium erinaceus extract (commonly known as lion’s mane mushroom). You get 90 gummies in every bottle for a 45-day steady supply of mushroom goodness. What makes these gummies stand out is the natural mixed berry flavour, making your daily dose a delicious treat. Try our vegan-friendly and gluten-free gummies and feel the benefits of mushrooms today! Benefits of Mushroom Complex Gummies Shiitake mushrooms are a natural source of vitamin D and riboflavin (vitamin B2). Maitake mushrooms offer the goodness of vitamin D and copper. Reishi mushrooms contain zinc, Auricularia auricula (wood ear mushroom) contains iron, and white mushrooms contain selenium, copper, riboflavin (vitamin B2), and niacin (vitamin B3). 8479.description_text: What Are Pure Marine Collagen Capsules? Are you looking for a natural solution for your ageing skin? Collagen is the new buzzword in the skincare industry, and might be exactly what you are looking for! Our Pure Marine Collagen Capsules provide high-absorbing hydrolysed Type 1 and Type 3 Titagen collagen, the two most useful forms of collagen found in your body. Packed with a potent 1200mg of fish collagen peptides per serving, our Marine Collagen Capsules help replenish your body’s natural collagen levels, which is an essential component of your skin, joints, bones and more. Let your body harness the collagen glow with our Pure Marine Collagen Capsules. Benefits of Pure Marine Collagen Capsules Collagen makes up around 30% of the proteins in our body, but as we age, our body’s ability to produce collagen starts declining. Decreasing collagen levels gives rise to evident symptoms such as joint pain, thinning hair, brittle bones and signs of premature ageing. That’s when collagen supplements come to the rescue! Here's how our Pure Marine Collagen Capsules benefit you: Advanced hydrolysed Type I and III collagen, the two types which make up about 90% of your body's total collagen. Helps restore your declining collagen levels found in skin and joints. Collagen is present in the hair, scalp and is, therefore, needed for your hair. Offers hydrolysed collagen peptides to ensure better absorption Why Choose Our Pure Marine Collagen Capsules? Made with 20+ years of expertise, with expertly developed wellness supplements and devices. Offers both Type 1 and Type 3 collagen, unlike regular collagen supplements that only contain Type 1 collagen. Naturally sourced Titagen collagen from fish scales and hydrolysed for better absorption. Free from GMOs, Magnesium stearate and artificial additives for reliable consumption. Third-party lab-tested for heavy metals and contaminants to ensure purity and nothing else. Just 2 capsules a day - offering you 2 months’ uninterrupted supply. Gluten-free formula, perfect for those with gluten intolerance. Unflavoured and odourless capsules with no fishy or bitter aftertaste for convenient intake. Packed in recyclable PET bottles to lower our carbon footprint and be a more sustainable choice. Backed by our 90-day money-back guarantee, helping you try these capsules risk-free. 8483.description_text: What Are maxmedix Iron & Vitamin C Gummies for Kids? Both iron and vitamin C are vital for children's overall development. Unfortunately, human bodies can’t produce either of them naturally, making us primarily dependent on food or supplements to fulfil the requirements. That’s where we come in! With maxmedix Iron Gummies for Kids with Vitamin C, your child can fulfil their daily requirements with ease. Help your kids reap the much-needed benefits of iron and vitamin C with only one delicious mixed berry-flavoured gummy daily! How Do Iron Gummies for Kids with Vitamin C Benefit Your Little Ones? 8496.description_text: What Are Our Liposomal NAD+ With Resveratrol Capsules? Looking for an effortless way to help you get through those busy, hectic days? Then try our Liposomal NAD+ with Resveratrol Capsules today! NAD+, or Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide, is a vital coenzyme present in every living cell, making it a vital component of your body. As we age, the natural levels of NAD start declining, and other lifestyle factors can make it difficult to maintain its optimal levels. We've packed together the goodness of this powerful coenzyme, along with trans-resveratrol and phospholipid complex, into our easy-to-swallow capsules so you can reap all their benefits effortlessly. Each bottle contains 90 capsules for a 3-month uninterrupted supply. So, take the first step to better wellness with NAD+ today! Benefits of Our Liposomal NAD+ With Resveratrol Capsules Our capsules offer a potent 250mg dose of Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD+) in every capsule. You also get 225mg of phospholipid complex and 100mg of trans-resveratrol. Here are the ways the ingredients in our NAD supplement benefit you: Tops up your body's natural levels of NAD+, which is needed for several biological processes Resveratrol is known for cardiovascular health* Liposomal form of NAD makes it more easily absorbable in the body, helping you feel the effects better Goodness of phospholipid complex, sourced from sunflower lecithin Benefits of trans-resveratrol as a natural polyphenol, sourced from Japanese knotweed with 98% purity Why Choose Our Liposomal NAD+ With Resveratrol Capsules? 8499.description_text: What Are Our Hydrolysed Marine Collagen With Magnesium Capsules? Noticing your joints creak every time you get up? Finding it tough to walk or climb stairs due to weak bones? You're not alone. With age, problems like stiff joints and brittle bones can be common, hampering your day-to-day activities. But not anymore! Our Marine Collagen With Magnesium Capsules are formulated with 1200mg of hydrolysed marine collagen to replenish the levels of your body’s key structural protein, collagen, so you can enjoy every step with confidence. Unlike regular marine collagen supplements, ours is packed with magnesium, vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, zinc, CoQ10 and bamboo extract - perfect to experience benefits beyond just a collagen boost. Experience the goodness of seven active ingredients in each dose with our Marine Collagen With Magnesium Capsules today! Benefits of Our Marine Collagen With Magnesium Capsules Collagen is the most abundant protein in our bodies, which acts as the building block for vital tissues like skin, muscles, bones and ligaments. Although it's naturally present in these body parts, its declining levels may lead to premature skin ageing, stiff joints, weak bones, etc. Our hydrolysed marine collagen supplements: Help replenish your body's Type 1 and Type 3 collagen levels Offers collagen, which forms a key component of the scalp that supports the roots of your hair Contains hydrolysed Titagen collagen peptides, which absorb easily into your body Here’s how the additional active ingredients help complement the benefits of hydrolysed marine collagen - Magnesium (Highly absorbable magnesium bisglycinate form) Contributes to electrolyte balance* Contributes to normal muscle function and normal protein synthesis* Contributes to the maintenance of normal bones and teeth* Has a role in the process of cell division* Vitamin C (High-absorbing L-ascorbic acid form) Contributes to the normal collagen formation for the normal function of skin, bones, gums, teeth, cartilage and blood vessels* Contributes to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue* Contributes to the normal function of the immune system* Hyaluronic Acid Hyaluronic acid is naturally found in skin, joints and eyes. Our collagen and hyaluronic acid supplements help restore your hyaluronic acid levels, which keep falling with age. Zinc (Super bioavailable zinc bisglycinate form) Zinc contributes to the maintenance of normal skin, hair, nails and bones.* CoQ10 Our capsules replenish your body's natural CoQ10 levels, which decline with age. CoQ10 is found in every cell of the body, which makes it essential to maintain its level. Bamboo Extract Bamboo is naturally rich in Silica. Silica is found in glycosaminoglycans, which are key compounds in structural tissues, like skin, bones and cartilage. Why Choose WeightWorld's Marine Collagen With Magnesium Capsules? Not sure whether to take it or not? Check out why our marine collagen with magnesium supplement is a perfect pick for you! 1200mg of marine collagen per serving, a potency higher than many other marine collagen supplements on the market Made using Titagen marine collagen, which is hydrolysed for better absorption than regular marine collagen tablets Provides two of the most abundant forms of collagen found in the body, Type 1 and Type 3 Blend of collagen, magnesium, vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, coenzyme Q10, bamboo and zinc, a powerful combination rarely found in other marine collagen tablets GMP-certified and free from GMOs and magnesium stearate to ensure no known side effects Just 3 marine collagen with hyaluronic acid capsules a day, enough to enjoy over 1 month’s supply of collagen goodness without reordering Gluten-free and lactose-free collagen and hyaluronic acid supplements, safe for you even if you have gluten intolerance or lactose intolerance Backed by a 90-day money-back guarantee, so you can try our collagen with vitamin C capsules risk-free for 3 months *These health claims are authorised by the European Food Safety Authority.
